items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps oily-feeling skin fresh without stripping it while you start a new active.
A 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting strength to help smooth the look of uneven texture.
A light barrier moisturizer supports comfort and hydration, which scored on the lower side, while retinol settles in.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside retinol and helps protect the look of even skin tone.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol 2 to 3 nights a week at first, moisturize after, and wear the SPF every morning. I left out the glycolic toner and benzoyl peroxide wash because using all three together is likely to leave skin dry and irritated and slow your progress, so add one later only if your skin is comfortable.
